name: Erelel
source:
A succubus, dweller of the night world. She preyed on males night after night, but her insatiable lust became so excessive that access to the gender realm was restricted.

With her alluring form, she captivates males, devouring their bodily fluids until they are drained of vitality—a terrifying habit.

!!!DANGER!!!

Warning: Male deficiency in effect! Currently prowling for men!

【Lion King's Strategy Memo】

"Even accounting for being a succubus, she's a really huge slut. If you run into her, just accept your bad luck. Huh? Me? Of course I'll turn the tables on her with my greatsword."

[From [url=http://clockup.net/makohun/character/11/]official site[/url]]
